page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.16xlarge belongs to the general-purpose ecs.g9i instance family and operates on the x86_64 architecture through a KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors operating at 3.2 GHz. Memory allocation stands at 256.0 GB, establishing a consistent 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per dedicated virtual core.

The instance profile does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators, which shifts disk persistence and input/output demands entirely to external network-attached block storage volumes. Network performance features a baseline throughput of 28 Gbps, providing substantial capacity for inter-service communication and remote storage traffic. Public network connectivity requires separate addressing configurations, as zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provided.

From an architectural perspective, the 1:4 resource distribution offers cost-effective scaling for applications that require predictable CPU execution without the premium overhead of memory-heavy or GPU-accelerated tiers. The dedicated core model prevents host-level contention across active threads. This server configuration aligns with scale-out application tiers, multi-container orchestration environments, distributed build and CI/CD pipelines, enterprise web serving, and database backend workloads.
